comment: kiln.markers on the game client (dossier chapter 04 §2.3/§3, docs/re/map.md; client 26430625). markers.client_map: the guards of the native map list kiln.markers appends to in a completed client step, never calling the game's append: the clear program's three count offsets (markers/Clear), the entry layout (two independent strategies of @markers/Entry, and the type id store @markers/EntryType), the four list capacities of 1024 at their offsets (@markers/ListCapacity) and the 0xa0 entry stride (@markers/EntryStride: index*5<<5). The fixed constants must equal their captures: a layout change turns the feature off, it is not followed. markers.anchors.client: the server-world anchor names plus the network create site and its entity/parent stack fields, reused from net.json (net/CreateTemplateCall, @net.create_fields) and not declared again (chapter 04 §4.2). Research-only symbols of the proposal (waypoint, boss, compass, canvas, fog) are not shipped.
